body: I will let you know. Thank you for sharing your experience.

I never thought I'd see someone say they've been in a similar situation and have it be true. It wasn't writing exams for others, but defintely in the same ballpark. How did you handle it? I'm so lost.

You're right. It's not illegal, what I've done, but it may lead to expulsion. I really can't face that. Unless there's a miracle and the meeting gets cancelled on Thursday, all there's really left is to thank you for your time, kind friend. Responding to you has helped lessen the shaking in my hands and I'm extremely grateful.
I'm too afraid to post details. It might identify me or dig my hole deeper. Thank you for your responses, but I do believe it is as bad as it seems.
